approaches.name: digital platforms, supercomputing and scholarship tracking for higher education
approaches.description: The project digitizes ISEP curricula, strengthens IT networks, boosts supercomputer use for big-data research, and runs SENBOURSE to track scholarships transparently. Practices: Digitized program-content platform consolidating ISEP curricula and IT networks; Supercomputer capacity for big-data research and training; SENBOURSE system tracking higher education scholarships transparently.
approaches.why_innovative: Digital core: shared ISEP content platform | New: consolidated digitized curricula across ISEP network | Adoption: 'would be improved' | category Technological; adoption apply; judged in 1 round(s); final check: digital core, in_use before 2019

evidence.text: This platform would be improved to consolidate digitized contents of programs; the design of strategic plans and economic models to strengthen the sustainability of ISEPs; the implementation of quality assurance standards; the reinforcement of IT networks for the information system; the establishment of a human resource strategy and of the related legal framework; the setting of a mechanism for teachers’ frequent immersion into companies to allow adaptation to market needs; and planning for sustained capacity building for teachers, technicians, and managers.

extra_evidence.text: The project will make specific investments to enhance research capacity within the country by supporting improved use of big data.
This includes supporting better utilization of Senegal’s supercomputer which in its current state, is not being fully exploited for research and training.

(b) Improve operationalization of the Integrated Higher Education and Research Information System (Système Intégré de Gestion de l’Enseignement Supérieur et de la Recherche, SIGESR) by building on the previously developed infrastructure and digital applications (including ensuring functionality of SENBOURSE which is meant to transparently track higher education scholarships); and (c) Provide support to the growing network of Open Digital Spaces that are being designed to deliver a set of teaching modules for distance learning and are meant to be collectively shared by universities.

category.rationale: Technological: digital content platform and IT system are the mechanism

sector.rationale: Digitizing ISEP curricula and IT systems directly serves higher education institutions.

adoption.rationale: Digital core: ISEP content platform | Innovative: shared digitized curricula network | Category: digital platform

approaches.innovation_basis: Digital core: shared ISEP content platform | New: consolidated digitized curricula across ISEP network | Adoption: 'would be improved'
